history.summary: At the $1,488,888 ask ($2,065 psf) this 721 sqft 2BR is fairly priced and sits inside the 2026 transacted band ($2,059-$2,131 psf for the 720-743 sqft cluster) — but it is NOT the best-value unit in its own development. A near-identical 721 sqft twin (listing 60147887) is listed ~$9k cheaper, and a larger 743 sqft 2BR is on the market at $1,992 psf for roughly the same ~$1.48M total. Fundamentals are sound (UOL, 797 units, 5-min walk to Bartley MRT, ~88yr lease) but gross yield is only ~3.1% and there is no fresh catalyst. Neutral at the ask; a Buy at ~$1.42-1.45M with floor/facing confirmed.
history.rating_rationale: (1) Fair, not cheap: $2,065 psf is mid-band vs Jan-May 2026 transactions ($2,059-$2,131 psf for ~720-743 sqft) — you are paying market, not below it. (2) Two better-value live alternatives exist in the SAME project: a same-size 721 sqft twin ~$9k cheaper and a LARGER 743 sqft unit at $1,992 psf (~$73 psf less) for similar money — so there is no relative reason to take this exact unit at ask. (3) Yield is only ~3.1-3.2% gross, below the 4% bar at this price. (4) Held up by genuine strengths — UOL build quality, 797-unit liquidity, real 5-min MRT walk, healthy ~88yr lease — which is why this is Neutral, not Avoid. Flips to Buy if negotiated to ~$1.42-1.45M and the stack/floor/facing check out.

history.summary: The 1BR is the value + yield pick of the whole development. history.summary: Within 2BR, the standout buy is the TRUE 656/657 sqft 2-bedroom at $1.29M ($1,963 psf) - the lowest psf among all 2BRs, a conventional (non-dual-key) layout with the broadest resale appeal, and a very liquid ~$1.3M quantum. The 721-732 sqft 2BR Flexi/Dual-Key units ($1.48-1.65M, $2,053-2,250 psf) are only Neutral: niche dual-key layout and higher psf. Buy the 657; be selective on the Flexi.

history.summary: The 3BR is the weakest investment case at current asks. Live listings are $2.30-2.38M ($2,422-2,570 psf) - the HIGHEST psf in the development and at/above the April 2026 benchmark high ($2,407 psf). Above $2M the buyer pool thins to families, and yield is the lowest (~2.7%). Aggressively priced; Avoid at ask, reconsider only on a meaningful discount.
history.rating_rationale: (1) $2,422-2,570 psf is above the project's recent record and well over the ~$2,176 avg - you'd be setting a new high, not buying value. (2) >$2.3M quantum shrinks the buyer pool to families only, hurting liquidity and exit. (3) ~2.7% gross yield is the weakest sub-type. (4) Capital growth from here is capped by an already-mature location with no new catalyst. Not an outright structural reject (good unit, good project) - but at these asks it's a no-buy. Reconsider at <= ~$2.15M (~$2,250 psf).
